taste:
This jacket potato combines a hot, fluffy centre and crisp skin with a cool, creamy tuna filling. The potato is split open and generously filled, so the savoury mixture sits against the soft interior. Flaked tuna gives the topping texture, while rich mayonnaise brings it together. The earthy potato flavour provides a straightforward base rather than competing with the filling.

Alongside it, the fresh side salad offers a crisp contrast to the softer potato and mayonnaise. Its light vinaigrette keeps the salad distinct from the richer filling. Expect a substantial lunchtime dish built around contrasting temperatures and textures, rather than a battered or breaded fish meal.

Freshly Battered Cod and Chips and Whitby Breaded Scampi are alternatives in the same section if you prefer battered or breaded fish. The jacket potato offers a different balance of textures, with a creamy filling and crisp salad.
